exclusions.reason: Well-grounded culinary variant, but the current authored Frigănele description specifically says bread. Excluded from this unchanged-concept batch rather than silently broadening an accepted concept record.
Compote fruit can be used in Diplomat, but this pair is too broad without its distinctive cake construction and setting ingredients. Not promoted into a candidate.

exclusions.idea: Cașcaval pane / Chiftele de legume / Legume la grătar + Pâine → Sandviș
exclusions.reason: Not authored: adding a whole cluster of bread fillings would spend this small batch on repetitive sandwich alternatives. Omelette is the one retained everyday case.

proposals.explanation: Oul fiert tare, tăiat, se amestecă cu cartofi fierți și răciți, ceapă și un sos după gust pentru salată de cartofi cu ou.
proposals.player_route: Ou + Apă → Ou fiert; Ou fiert + Cartof → Salată de cartofi.
proposals.rationale: Reuses the terminal boiled-egg discovery in a familiar cold salad. The explanation names both the hard-boiled state and cooked, cooled potatoes. It is a variant of the existing potato-salad definition, with no new regional claim.
proposals.review_risk: Potato and egg can also be baked together, but the cold-salad result is a common defensible outcome and does not conflict with any existing pair.

proposals.explanation: Omleta pusă între două felii de pâine formează un sandviș, cu legume sau brânză după gust.
proposals.player_route: Ou + Lapte → Omletă; Făină + Apă → Aluat; Aluat + Cuptor de bucătărie → Pâine; Omletă + Pâine → Sandviș.
proposals.rationale: Makes the currently terminal omelette reusable through a clear breakfast idea. The world already teaches bread plus a prepared filling; this candidate gives that established rule one missing everyday case, rather than adding many fillings.
proposals.review_risk: Sandviș already has many alternatives. Retain only if removing this obvious dead end is worth one more recipe; no claim of a new result or new theme.

proposals.explanation: Mousse-ul de ciocolată poate umple o bază din biscuiți mărunțiți și legați cu unt; tarta se lasă la rece să se întărească.
proposals.player_route: Cacao + Lapte praf → Ciocolată; Smântână dulce pentru frișcă + Mixer de bucătărie → Frișcă; Ciocolată + Frișcă → Mousse de ciocolată; Făină + Unt → Biscuit; Mousse de ciocolată + Biscuit → Tartă.
proposals.rationale: Gives a further use to completed chocolate mousse by treating it as tart filling. The current Tartă definition explicitly permits a biscuit base. The explanation states the butter binder and chilling, so it describes assembly rather than claiming that a loose biscuit and mousse instantly form a tart.
proposals.review_risk: The existing Ganache + Biscuit → Tartă is a nearby precedent. Mousse is already a distinct world concept; the benefit is its first outgoing recipe, not a novel tart result. Independent quality review may prefer to keep only the two more everyday candidates.
